channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: The BIS remote-access rule now has named targets. On 23 November Commerce filed a final rule adding seven Megaspeed-linked companies in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand to the Entity List, with all EAR items licensed under a presumption of denial, and Malaysia told its data centre operators not to host or serve them. Capital is still pricing compute as an asset class: Apollo and Goldman priced about $44 billion of notes to buy Nvidia Vera Rubin systems for SpaceX, the largest GPU financing yet, with lease schedules starting in the first half of 2027. Spain's Royal Decree 1032/2026 took effect on 22 November, tying grid access for data centres to 80 per cent hourly-matched new renewables and curtailment duties, and TSMC filed for a possible 2nm fab in Brazos County, Texas, while saying no customer has changed orders. List prices held for a twelfth straight trading day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69.

item.title: Compute brief - 24 November 2026
item.description: The BIS remote-access rule now has named targets. On 23 November Commerce filed a final rule adding seven Megaspeed-linked companies in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand to the Entity List, with all EAR items licensed under a presumption of denial, and Malaysia told its data centre operators not to host or serve them. Capital is still pricing compute as an asset class: Apollo and Goldman priced about $44 billion of notes to buy Nvidia Vera Rubin systems for SpaceX, the largest GPU financing yet, with lease schedules starting in the first half of 2027. Spain's Royal Decree 1032/2026 took effect on 22 November, tying grid access for data centres to 80 per cent hourly-matched new renewables and curtailment duties, and TSMC filed for a possible 2nm fab in Brazos County, Texas, while saying no customer has changed orders. List prices held for a twelfth straight trading day: 70 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW, with Lambda H100 at $4.59 and B200 at $7.69. Countries: Singapore: BIS adds Megaspeed International, Swiftdata and Apex Enterprise Solutions to the Entity List, presumption of denial (Wire, 23 Nov). Malaysia: Speedmatrix, MSFusion and PT Megaspeed listed; MITI tells operators not to host or serve them (Wire, 23 to 24 Nov). United States: Apollo and Goldman price about $44 billion of notes for SpaceX Vera Rubin GPUs; TSMC files for a possible Brazos County 2nm fab (Wire, 20 to 23 Nov). Spain: Royal Decree 1032/2026 in force 22 Nov: 80 per cent hourly-matched new renewables, curtailment duties, water and PUE limits (Wire). Taiwan: TSMC's Hou: no customer has changed orders or shipments; demand still exceeds capacity (Wire, 23 Nov). Thailand: NTT and B.Grimm MoU for a 400 MW opportunity, about THB 113 billion; Megaspeed (Thailand) also listed (Wire, 23 to 24 Nov, single-source).
